name: opt-console-preview
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same web app: the Smart-Clearance super-admin console, shown edge to edge with no browser window. Keep the reference's visual system exactly: pale sage-white background, the frosted left sidebar, white cards and inset grouped lists with thin hairline edges and soft shadows, the deep green brand colour, the heavy grotesque page title and the clean sans interface text. Replace every piece of the reference's content in the whole main area, top to bottom, including the lower half and the bottom-left corner. Layout: 1) Left sidebar: the green rounded-square S logo with "Smart-Clearance" and a small grey "Console" under it; navigation items "Overview", "Clients" (selected), "Agents", "Connectors", "Plans", "Staff", "Audit log"; at the bottom "Neha Kulkarni, Super admin" with a small round portrait. 2) Middle column (about half the width), top to bottom with nothing else in it: the title "Munchly Foods" with an orange rounded tile with a white letter m and "munchly.smartclearance.com" in monospace; a white card "Guardrails" with rows "Kirana scheme · buy 10, get 2 free", "ExpireSoon reserve · ₹13.50", "Staff sale cap · 50 packs", "Return window · 20 days", "Territory guard" with a green switch; a white card "Agents" with rows "Watcher · daily 09:00", "Negotiator · floor ₹13.50, counters twice", "Outreach · Hindi first, English on request"; a white card "Sign-in" with two rows "Google Workspace · munchly.in" and "Mobile number and code · by invitation". 3) Right column: a large live preview panel titled "Preview · munchly.smartclearance.com" showing a phone screen with the client's sign-in page (an orange rounded tile with a white letter m, "Munchly Foods", the address in a small grey pill, "Sign in", an email field and a green "Continue" button, "Powered by Smart-Clearance" at the foot), and under the phone a small white card "Route Room with these guardrails: 588 to kiranas · 772 to ExpireSoon · net ₹21,770". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Option: Settings beside the workspace, with a live preview of the client's sign-in page.
